intro: Wrestling is Iran's most successful Olympic sport, while football draws the biggest crowds.

chapters.title: Wrestling and weightlifting
text: Wrestling has an ancient tradition in Iran, including the zurkhaneh ('house of strength'), where athletes train to drums and poetry. Most of Iran's Olympic golds come from wrestling, weightlifting and taekwondo.

chapters.title: Football
text: Team Melli has qualified for several World Cups and won the Asian Cup three times. For decades women were barred from watching men's matches in stadiums, a ban that has been eased only partly.
